statement: FASB's ASU 2023-09 (Dec 2023) requires added income tax disclosures; Apple adopts it in Q4 2026
quote: In December 2023, the Financial Accounting Standards Board (the “FASB”) issued Accounting Standards Update (“ASU”) No. 2023-09, Income Taxes (Topic 740): Improvements to Income Tax Disclosures (“ASU 2023-09”), which will require the Company to disclose specified additional information in its income tax rate reconciliation and provide additional information for reconciling items that meet a quantitative threshold.
notes: borderline: an accounting standard counted as a regulation that applies to the company
